entries.226706866e56af72: Its management policy sets out a “customer-centric” principle, and it develops its business centered on integrated production of computer forms, from planning, design and manufacturing through to delivery. Under its medium- to long-term strategy, it will work to further improve efficiency in “Printing-related” and “DPP,” where paperless practices are advancing, while developing “WEB” and “BPO” as priority fields aligned with customers’ DX initiatives. Regarding its production structure, it is carrying out a fundamental review, gradually dispersing the functions of the Takao Plant to other sites, and after repairing and renovating the building of the former Takao Plant, developing it as a base equipped with new functions. The medium-term management plan announced in February 2024 also sets out, as its first priority, “business expansion in priority fields through new product categories.”
